preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect vertices within the range from 1 to n.
The number of pairs of interesting vertices k must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n and xi != yi for xi, yi in pairs)
preconditions.description: Each pair of interesting vertices must be valid and distinct.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly k lines, one for each pair of interesting vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= count < 1000000007 for count in counts)
postconditions.description: Each count of distinct simple paths must be non-negative and less than 1000000007.

postconditions.expression: all(count == counts[i] for i, count in enumerate(counts))
postconditions.description: The output must match the calculated counts of distinct simple paths for each pair.
